scripts.sync:web: cp www/index.html www/storage.js www/sw.js www/manifest.json . && echo '根目錄網頁版(GitHub Pages)已同步自 www/'
scripts.diff:web: for f in index.html storage.js sw.js manifest.json; do diff -q "www/$f" "$f" >/dev/null || { echo "不同步: $f (www/ 是唯一來源，請跑 npm run sync)"; exit 1; }; done && echo '根目錄與 www/ 一致'
scripts.sync: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync ios
